name: Stink Arms
bodyType: Four-armed humanoid with insect wings and eyestalks

debut.episode: Dr. Animo and the Mutant Ray

abilities: Enhanced strength (swatted the Mutant Frog with a metal alligator statue)
weaknesses: Too heavy to fly properly - only hovers and makes small hops
Weaker than pure Four Arms (couldn't hold the Mutant Frog up for long)
summary: The first-ever Omnitrix fusion: Four Arms' body wearing Stinkfly's eyestalks, wings and tail, created when Dr. Animo's mutant ray scrambled the watch.
traits: First combination alien in the franchise
Omnitrix on his face like Stinkfly
Designed by Thomas N. Perkins IV
notableFeats: Battled Dr. Animo's Mutant Frog and sent it flying (Dr. Animo and the Mutant Ray)

appearances.firstEpisode: Dr. Animo and the Mutant Ray
notableEpisodes: Dr. Animo and the Mutant Ray
appearances.designNotes: Four Arms' red four-armed body with Stinkfly's four eyestalks, wings and stinger tail; shirt based on Stinkfly's suit with Four Arms' pants; Omnitrix on the face/forehead.

scoring.rationale: A weaker Four Arms with a hint of Stinkfly: still strong enough to hurl a mutant frog, but he cannot really fly and lost some of the Tetramand muscle.

notes: Fusion of Four Arms + Stinkfly (componentIds); one-episode OS accident.
Also appears in the Reboot-era online game DNA Lab - out of scope.
